usedFor: Webinargeek tracks registrations and viewers, and Google Drive shares a file through “Share File With Anyone” after “New Registration”.

bestTemplate.name: “Assessment Passed” in Webinargeek, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A viewer who passes the assessment can trigger a shareable link with Viewer, Commenter or Editor access.

watchOut: “Share File With Anyone” opens a file by link, so set access to Viewer unless people should comment or edit.
